notes.title: Changing of the Guards
notes.content:
We have completed a new set of guards with one for each nation.  They will be at entrance of castle and have been added in throne room scene as well.

Enjoy!

notes.title: 5 new bartenders and new voice work!
notes.content:
We moved up a new version today.  We now have a separate bartender for each nation!  We will be starting on guards next and eventually each nation will have all of their own characters.  

We had a lot of Wonfourn specific voice work done and this makes it feel much nicer.  We hope everyone enjoys it!  Many little things on archery scene, jousting and reported bugs were fixed.  

We hope you all enjoy the new version and we look forward to continued feedback.

notes.title: Wonfourn Update - Quests Opened Up - 25.06.2018
notes.content:
We have made the following improvements in this update:

1. Opens up all nation quests regardless of character playing.  This should make game much more fun and give more to do.  We had each nation having own quests depending on character you play, but this was not a good way for people to experience the game.  Each character still has other strengths as described.
2. Fix for sky and weather in dragon archery scene.
3. Frame rate improvements in all scenes and slight improvement in loading times.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Wonfourn released - let the adventures begin!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

We are very excited to announce the release of Wonfourn.  We hope you all enjoy it and look forward to your feedback.  

Best Regards,
Sam DenHartog

notes.title: April showers bring May flowers
notes.content:
We have moved back our release date to April 30th, 2018.  We feel there is so much more we can do before first release and want to take the time to get it all great!  Thanks for your patience. 

We do planning on releasing a new trailer video by end of November 2017 yet that will have a lot more gameplay footage.  We are very excited about Wonfourn!
